verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching scheduling is that dbt Projects on Snowflake lets you 'develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe' transformations on managed dbt runtimes. That implies workflow orchestration but never explicitly documents recurring schedules. Snowpipe and streams are event-driven or change-tracking features rather than schedulers, and the community mentions of daily automations and scheduled dbt queries describe user-side arrangements, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native scheduler (e.g., cron or interval-based recurring jobs), workflow dependency/DAG definition, details on scheduling via API or CLI for AI-native use, and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs.
